title: Samarium(III) Pentalene Sandwich Compounds [Sm(η8-C8H4{SiiPr3-1,4}2)(Cp*)] and [Sm(η8-C8H4{SiiPr3-1,4}2)(η5-C8H5{SiiPr3-1,4}2)] and a Mixed-Valence Hexasamarium Cluster Derived from Sm(II)-Based Solvent Activation

synthesis.procedure: Under purified argon in a glass ampule, a toluene (15 mL) solution of C8H4{SiiPr3-1,4}2[K]2 (88 mg, 0.180 mmol) was added dropwise with stirring to a suspension of [SmICp*(THF)2]2 (200 mg, 0.180 mmol) in toluene (20 mL). After 48 h of stirring at 80 °C under partial static vacuum, the green solution was filtered from red and white solids through Celite and the solvent was removed in vacuo. The pale olive-green oily solid was heated at 100 °C / 10^-6 mbar for 5 h. Compound 1 cocrystallizes with small amounts of 2 as a dark green solid from a concentrated toluene solution (1 mL) cooled at −50 °C over 4 days. Yield 70 mg (0.1 mmol), 56% of 1 based on 1 equiv of the pentalene salt (27% based on 0.5 equiv of the Sm precursor), ignoring the impurity of 2.
synthesis.time: 48 h stirring; 5 h vacuum heating; 4 days crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: glass ampule; Schlenk/high-vacuum/glovebox under argon; Celite filtration
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filter from red/white solids through Celite; remove solvent in vacuo; heat at 100 °C / 10^-6 mbar for 5 h; crystallize from concentrated toluene (1 mL) at −50 °C over 4 days (cocrystallizes with 2)
synthesis.yield: 70 mg (0.1 mmol), 56% of 1 based on 1 equiv C8H4{SiiPr3-1,4}2[K]2 (27% based on 0.5 equiv [SmICp*(THF)2]2), ignoring impurity of 2

synthesis.procedure: Formed as a minor toluene-soluble coproduct in the same ampule reaction used for 1: C8H4{SiiPr3-1,4}2[K]2 (88 mg, 0.180 mmol) in toluene (15 mL) was added to [SmICp*(THF)2]2 (200 mg, 0.180 mmol) in toluene (20 mL), stirred 48 h at 80 °C, filtered, stripped, and heated at 100 °C / 10^-6 mbar for 5 h. 2 cocrystallizes with 1 from concentrated toluene at −50 °C and could not be separated. A separate attempt from SmI2(THF)2 and C8H5{SiiPr3-1,4}2[K] gave a dark green oil with an EI mass spectrum matching 2 that could not be crystallized.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: glass ampule under argon; Schlenk/high-vacuum techniques
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: same workup as 1; cocrystallizes from concentrated toluene at −50 °C; not isolated in pure form

material_class.structural_family: oxo-centered hexanuclear octahedral methoxide-bridged mixed-valence Sm cluster salt

synthesis.procedure: The red and white toluene-insoluble solids from the 1/2 preparation ([SmICp*(THF)2]2, 200 mg, 0.180 mmol; C8H4{SiiPr3-1,4}2[K]2, 88 mg, 0.180 mmol; toluene, 48 h at 80 °C) were collected on Celite and extracted with THF to give a dark blue/red dichroic, moisture-sensitive solution. Solvent was removed in vacuo and the solid recrystallized from THF/hexane (1:5; Results also cite THF/pentane 1:5) by cooling at −50 °C for 3 days, yielding extremely air-sensitive dark red crystals of 3. Isolated in 20% yield based on 3 equiv of [SmICp*(THF)2]2 (30 mg, 0.0123 mmol). Cluster methoxide/oxo ligands arise from Sm(II)-mediated THF activation; the crystal is refined with 0.5 I replacing 0.5 OMe.

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: extract red/white Celite solids with THF; remove solvent in vacuo; recrystallize from THF/hexane (1:5) or THF/pentane (1:5) at −50 °C for 3 days
synthesis.yield: 30 mg (0.0123 mmol), 20% based on 3 equiv of [SmICp*(THF)2]2

properties.summary: Described as highly paramagnetic (no 1H NMR signals; formulated as mixed-valence Sm(II)3/Sm(III)3) but no magnetic susceptibility or optical spectroscopic measurements are reported.
